title: Pixel Arena UI Kit
beatNote: the current kit (kits/game-ui, order O-011) is HTML and CSS only: no PNG, no font file and no layout data an engine can load; this pack adds all three
assetsFrom: none copied: every pixel of the atlas, the font and the icons is authored here (CC0)
pictureNote: the pictures are composed by tools/ui-pack.mjs from ui-atlas.png, font-5x7.png and layout.json (preview-hud.png, preview-menu.png): they show the pack files working together, nothing is drawn outside them.
laneNote: game = the files an engine loads exist, not only HTML: ui-atlas.png + ui-atlas.json (27 pieces with 9-slice data), font-5x7.png + font-5x7.json + ds-pixel-5x7.ttf (95 glyphs, CC0), layout.json (HUD and menu, 640x360 reference), tokens.json; node tools/ui-pack.mjs --check prints UIPACK PASS.
fitNote: the kit sheet is a viewer of the pack, the pack files are the delivery
deliveryLines: Landing in forge: `from-design-studio/O-023/` (copy the whole folder; never edit a file outside from-design-studio/). engine2040 copies the same folder.

Load these: `ui-atlas.png` + `ui-atlas.json` (27 pieces, 9-slice `slice` data, nearest filter, integer scale), `font-5x7.png` + `font-5x7.json` (95 ASCII glyphs, 6x8 cells) and `ds-pixel-5x7.ttf` (same glyphs as outlines), `tokens.json`, `layout.json` (HUD and menu in a 640x360 reference).
Look at: `preview-hud.png`, `preview-menu.png`, `preview-atlas.png` (made from the files above by `node tools/ui-pack.mjs`), `page.html` + `out.png` (kit sheet), `thumb-256.png`.
How to adopt in 10 minutes: `ADOPT.md` (forge Rome step 7, engine2040 `engine-ui` text atlas). Licence: CC0 (`LICENSE.txt`), no third-party font or art data.
Gates: `brief.json`, `design-audit.json` (audit PASS), `DESIGN-REVIEW.md` (SHIP), `VERDICT.md`; here `node tools/ui-pack.mjs --check` -> UIPACK PASS.

Adopt: copy the folder, load the atlas and font from the JSON, build the HUD and menu from `layout.json`; forge cites `design-studio/kits/game-ui` and O-011 in its Rome file for `rome-score` step 7 and may add O-023.
Proof in forge or engine2040: `git log -1 --format=%h -- from-design-studio/O-023/ui-atlas.png`; here: `node tools/orders-check.mjs` and `node tools/audit.mjs designs/O-023/brief.json`.
factsNote: no store claim on this sheet; the counts in ADOPT.md (27 pieces, 95 glyphs, 640x360 reference) are read from ui-atlas.json, font-5x7.json and layout.json, and `node tools/ui-pack.mjs --check` prints UIPACK PASS
